news_analysis.breaking_event_summary: The Nifty 50 and Sensex fell 1% as crude oil crossed $102 per barrel, triggering a broad sell-off concentrated in financial and insurance stocks following a new IRDAI regulatory proposal.
news_analysis.retail_illusion: Retail investors assume a global crude oil price shock is causing a systemic market crash, leading them to panic-sell financial and insurance holdings.
news_analysis.institutional_reality: Institutions are using crude oil headlines as liquidity cover to trim financial exposure while absorbing insurance stocks at structural discounts ahead of IRDAI's regulatory margin realignment.
news_analysis.actionable_retail_rule: Never panic-sell index constituents on commodity macro headlines when the primary sell-off driver is a structural regulatory proposal.

comparison_data.myth: Crude oil price high-ah irukkuradhala dhan Nifty 1% crash aagudhu nu retail investors namburanga.
comparison_data.reality: Institutions crude oil-ah oru cover-ah vachukittu, IRDAI regulatory changes-ah use panni stocks-ah cheap-ah accumulate panranga.

stat_data.label: Nifty & Sensex fall
stat_data.context: Indha 1% fall-ah pathu panic aaguradhu unga capital-ku risk. Idhu crude oil-ala vandhadhu illa, IRDAI proposal-ala vandha structural realignment.

slides.title: Institutional liquidity trap
slides.card_text: 1. Retailers panic-la sell panranga. 2. Institutions indha liquidity-ah use panni insurance stocks-ah discount-la vanguranga. 3. Regulatory news-ah market-ah control panna oru tool-ah use panranga.

slides.title: Capital extraction mechanics
slides.card_text: Retail investors crude oil news-ah nambi stop-loss hit aaguranga. Institutions indha gap-ah use panni, structural discount-la irukkura financial stocks-ah silent-ah accumulate panni portfolio-va build panranga.

slides.title: Golden rule for smart traders
slides.card_text: Commodity macro headlines-ah pathu panic-sell pannadheenga. Especially index constituents-ah regulatory news-ala sell aagum podhu, adhu oru opportunity-nu purinjukonga.

slide_1_report.critique_summary: The typography is clean and legible, however, there is a significant cultural/linguistic oversight: the headline is written in 'Tanglish' (transliterated Tamil) rather than native Tamil script. While the visual contrast is high, the lack of actual Tamil Unicode characters for the primary content renders the 'Tamil' branding inaccurate. The English headline is well-balanced, but the '50,000 loss?' highlight box feels slightly cramped horizontally.
